## Context
The first live close after direct gated-close instrumentation produced authoritative timings at merged SHA 585888b7a0d4: `pre_verifier_total_ms=21971`, `verifier_call_ms=423502`, `llm_ms=175487.6`, `det_ms=10220.7`, and verifier `total_ms=185758.6`. Therefore 237743.4 ms inside the existing `verify_with_auto_resume` call is not explained by the verifier runtime metrics. That remainder must stay explicitly unattributed until direct boundaries identify it.

## Performance constraint
Instrumentation must only time already-existing synchronous sections with `time.monotonic_ns()`, integer arithmetic, and cheap dictionary assignments/counter increments. It must add no file or tracker read/write, Git subprocess, network/model call, retry, sleep, tracing backend, worker, lock, extra traversal, or new sidecar/event. Metrics must piggyback on the existing `COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics` payload and existing write.

## Investigation and implementation plan
- Map the exact call graph and timing ownership from the close wrapper through `verify_with_auto_resume`, gate dispatch, workflow execution, auto-resume, enrichment/drain, verdict normalization, signing inputs, and sidecar emission.
- Identify every existing synchronous segment included by `verifier_call_ms` but excluded from the inner verifier `total_ms`; do not name a cause from subtraction alone.
- Add direct monotonic phase timers at the smallest stable call-graph seams that form a closed partition of the wrapper interval. Thread one optional metrics collector through existing calls so callers without it remain unchanged.
- Preserve current consumption/runtime metrics. Add workload counts needed to interpret repeated passes, resume rounds, drain attempts, or equivalent existing work without adding traversal.
- Update the reusable duration probe to prefer the direct fields and report any arithmetic remainder only as explicitly unattributed.
- Add RED-first synthetic tests for propagation, partition arithmetic, existing-metric preservation, optional compatibility, no-extra-work behavior, and direct/legacy probe output.
- Re-run the standard-library bookkeeping microbenchmark and repository gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A model-backed PASS sidecar directly attributes the synchronous phases inside `verifier_call_ms`.
- [x] A model-backed FAIL sidecar directly attributes the same phases.
- [x] Named direct child phases plus explicitly measured wrapper overhead reconcile to `verifier_call_ms` with a maximum discrepancy of one millisecond per summed phase, capped at 10 ms; any larger difference is emitted as `unattributed_verifier_ms`.
- [x] Any remainder is labeled `unattributed` and is not assigned a causal operation name.
- [x] Existing `llm_ms`, `det_ms`, and `total_ms` remain unchanged.
- [x] Existing request, tool-call, and consumption metrics remain unchanged.
- [x] Existing repeated-pass/resume/drain workload is counted during the same traversal or calls that already perform it.
- [x] Instrumentation adds no I/O, subprocess, network/model call, tracker event/write, retry, sleep, tracing, worker, or lock.
- [x] Existing callers behave unchanged when no optional collector is supplied.
- [x] The duration probe reports direct wrapper phases and preserves legacy rows without causal inference.
- [x] Synthetic tests fail on current main and pass after implementation.
- [x] Complete added bookkeeping remains below 50 microseconds per close in a standard-library microbenchmark.
- [x] Focused tests pass.
- [x] The script import walk passes.
- [x] Lint and typecheck pass.
- [x] The default non-integration, non-external test suite passes.
- [x] This change edits neither `AGENTS.md` nor agent-duration guidance; any expectation update remains a separate follow-up after an adequate cohort and explicit user confirmation.
